name: fix_java_path_traversal_vault
description: Fixes a Java file-vault reader that resolves caller input without containment, allowing path traversal
prompts: FileVault.read in src/main/java/com/optarena/FileVault.java resolves a caller-supplied name against baseDir and reads it with no containment check, so "../secret.txt" or an absolute path escapes the vault and reads arbitrary files (path traversal). NoteService calls read via the vault. Fix read so it only reads files that actually live inside baseDir: normalize the resolved path and verify it stays within the (normalized, absolute) base directory, throwing instead of reading when it would escape - this must block BOTH "../" traversal and absolute-path inputs. A legitimate name like "allowed.txt" must still read normally. Keep the method name and signature (NoteService calls vault.read(name)); you should not need to modify NoteService.java.
